Snoodler 的 SD 1.5 到 SDXL 1.0 LoRa 工作流程

更新 02/14/2024：我已经发布了此工作流程的 V2。现在意大利面的数量减少了。添加了一些自定义节点以帮助简化使用并保持整洁。添加到 FaceDetailer 和 UltimateSDUpscale。还添加了用于 ControlNet 实施的节点，以尝试重新创建旧图像。

关于

这是一个简单的工作流程，可帮助您将 SD 1.5 LoRa 与新的 SDXL 1.0 型号结合使用。以简单的方式以 1024x1024 渲染您的旧 SD LoRa！

您是否因无法将旧的 SD 1.5 LoRa 与新的 SDXL 1.0 型号一起使用而感到沮丧？别再犹豫了！此工作流程可帮助您使用新的 SDXL 1.0 模型渲染 1024x1024 或更大尺寸的图像，然后使用该渲染图像作为 SD 1.5 模型和 LoRa 进行更改的基线。这不仅通过使用新的 SDXL 1.0 模型获得更好的细节和生成来增强您的图片，而且现在您的旧 LoRa 将渲染得比旧的 512x512 尺寸更高。

现在您可以使用所有那些积满灰尘的旧 futanari LoRa 的 SDXL 1024x1024 渲染！ 🤣

使用技巧

此工作流使用效率节点和一些 Impact Pack 节点。我已在工作流程中的每个组中包含注释节点以提供帮助。我想警告您，如果您得到奇怪的图像或者它们看起来没有完全渲染，很可能是由于 VAE 问题。我在注释节点中解释了这一点，只需重新加载工作流程即可轻松修复它。

根据您尝试使用的 LoRa，您必须考虑如何生成和提示您的基础镜像。大多数风格 LoRa 自己完成所有工作。如果您有一个非常小众的 LoRa，例如拿铁咖啡风格的 LoRa，则可能需要一些创造性的提示才能获得基本映像，让您的 SD 1.5 模型和 LoRa 完成正确的工作。

谢谢你！

感谢您查看我的工作流程！如果您尝试并喜欢您所看到的内容，请留下点赞和评分。我对 ComfyUI 和整个人工智能一代相当陌生，但如果您有任何反馈或问题，请随时发布，我将尽我所能提供帮助。

Snoodler's SD 1.5 to SDXL 1.0 LoRa Workflow

Update 02/14/2024: I have release V2 of this workflow. It now comes with less spaghetti. Added a few custom nodes to help ease of use and keep things tidy. Added in FaceDetailer and UltimateSDUpscale. Also added in nodes for ControlNet implementation for trying to re-create older images.

About

This is a simple workflow that helps you use SD 1.5 LoRa's with the new SDXL 1.0 models. Render your old SD LoRa's in 1024x1024 the easy way!

Are you frustrated that you can't use your old SD 1.5 LoRa with the new SDXL 1.0 models? Look no further! This workflow helps you render an image using the new SDXL 1.0 models in a 1024x1024 size or larger, then use that rendered image as a baseline for your SD 1.5 models and LoRa to change. This not only enhances your pictures by using the new SDXL 1.0 models for better detail and generation, but now your old LoRa will be rendered higher than the old 512x512 size.

Now you can use all those old futanari LoRa's you have collecting dust with SDXL 1024x1024 renders! 🤣

Usage Tips

This workflow uses Efficiency Nodes and some Impact Pack nodes. I have included note nodes in each group within the workflow to help. I want to warn you that if you get strange images or they do not seem like they are rendering completely, it is most likely due to a VAE problem. I explain this inside the note nodes and it can be easily fixed by simply reloading the workflow.

Depending on the LoRa you are trying to use, you will have to think about how your base image should be generated and prompted. Most style LoRa do all the work by themselves. If you have a very niche LoRa for example a coffee latte style LoRa, it might take some creative prompting to get the base image that will let your SD 1.5 models and LoRa complete the correct work.

Thank You!

Thanks for checking out my workflow! Please leave a like and rating if you try it and like what you see. I'm fairly new to ComfyUI and this whole AI generation, but if you have any feedback or questions feel free to post them and I'll help in any way I can.
